title: 1985 AMC 8 Problem 23
statement: King Middle School has \(1200\) students. Each student takes \(5\) classes a day. Each teacher teaches \(4\) classes. Each class has \(30\) students and \(1\) teacher. How many teachers are there at King Middle School?

solutions.text:
Each day there are \(1200 \times 5 = 6000\) student-class attendances. Since each class holds \(30\) students, there are \(\dfrac{6000}{30} = 200\) classes.

Each teacher teaches \(4\) classes, so there are \(\dfrac{200}{4} = 50\) teachers.

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: Count the total number of student-class attendances: \(1200 \times 5\)
Divide by \(30\) to get the number of classes, then by \(4\) to get the number of teachers
